process.headline: From first message to site live

steps.title: Initial conversation
steps.description: I need to understand what you need, who the site is for, and what it has to do. No quote is trustworthy without this.

steps.title: Proposal and timeline
steps.description: You get scope, timeline, and price in writing, before a single line of code gets written.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Staged progress with review points along the way, not one surprise delivery at the end.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.description: Site goes live, domain and hosting configured, with a support window included for fine-tuning.
